_comment: Shape of the SITES secret. Copy to sites.json (gitignored), fill in real values, then: wrangler secret put SITES < sites.json. The key is the site's origin exactly as the browser sends it — scheme, host, no trailing slash, and one entry per domain the site answers on (with and without www if both are live). Every entry needs at least one complete delivery channel: LINE (lineToken AND lineTo), email (emailTo, with RESEND_KEY and EMAIL_FROM set as their own secrets), or both. An entry with neither is refused with a 500 rather than accepting forms it cannot deliver.
